text: flocc setup and flocc keys take each key from the process environment or the .env at the root of the flocc checkout before prompting, and store a new or changed value only after the paste checks pass
author: claude-code
rationale: The environment overriding the file is the usual dotenv convention and lets a one-off run override a key. Reading the file only in flocc's own checkout keeps another project's .env, which may hold unrelated FLOCC_ names, from being picked up. Checking before storing keeps a stale or mistyped .env from replacing a working key.
revisit: flocc is run from an installed binary outside any checkout, so the checkout-root .env is no longer where owners keep keys
choice: Source: .env at git rev-parse --show-toplevel, read only when the root go.mod declares module github.com/NovusEdge/flocc; outside a flocc checkout only the environment counts. Precedence: a non-empty variable in the process environment overrides the file. Check-then-store: a value equal to the stored key is skipped (Tailscale compared by secret); a new or changed one goes through the same prefix and live checks as a paste; a failure is shown masked with the reason and the stored key stays; a changed Linear key or GitHub token is offered for push to every host through rotate's push code; a changed ntfy topic waits for the next ship.
alternatives: Store .env values without the live check
Let the .env win over the environment
Read .env from the current directory wherever flocc runs

fields.cost_if_wrong: Small: the loader and Take are about 250 lines behind envKeys; changing the source or precedence touches envfile.go and the docs keys page, and no stored key is ever replaced by an unchecked value.
